products.name: Tome
products.note: AI storytelling; presentation generation; narrative design; creative IP

reading.body:
Tome is an AI presentation tool that generates slides and narratives, competing in a market where generative AI has commodified the basic cognitive work of structuring information into visual arguments.

The product's core function, narrative design through AI, reflects how foundation models now handle tasks requiring synthesis rather than raw computation. This shifts professional work from execution to curation: users prompt and refine rather than build from blank slides. The market for such tools depends on low inference costs and fast response times, both products of the compute and power infrastructure that makes real-time generation viable.

The data does not specify Tome's inference requirements, deployment model, or whether it requires real-time queries or batch processing. It does not indicate whether the product depends on external model APIs or proprietary infrastructure. For understanding Tome's actual power and compute footprint, this context matters more than its category.
